## Download

Download NullPlayer for macOS:

https://github.com/ad-repo/nullplayer/releases/latest/download/NullPlayer.dmg

Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or newer.

## Install

NullPlayer is signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized by Apple.

1. Open the downloaded DMG.
2. Drag `NullPlayer.app` to Applications.
3. Open NullPlayer from Applications.

Prefer Homebrew? See the [install guide](https://github.com/ad-repo/nullplayer/blob/main/docs/download.md).
